stories.story: Lily wanted to read a storybook inside, but the door was locked. The key was missing. Dad said, “I can help you.” Lily said, “I want to find the key.” Lily fetched the lantern from the porch. Lily used the lantern to find the key under the bench. Lily unlocked the door with the key, and she stepped inside the cottage. Lily hung the key on the hook. Lily opened the storybook beside Dad.
